svg.title: Deploy flow: one run of deploy.yml, from trigger to hand-off
svg.desc: Three triggers start deploy.yml: the repository_dispatch event infrastructure-changed from terraform, which carries the drained_nodes list; a push to main; and a manual workflow_dispatch. Job provision runs on the self-hosted runner. It acquires the maintenance lock, verifies it, runs k3s.yml, releases the lock only after success, and uploads the encrypted kubeconfig as the artifact kubeconfig-handoff. k3s.yml has eight plays: wait for SSH availability on all nodes (all_k3s); initialize k3s cluster (masters[0], role k3s_init); harvest cluster token and VIP check (masters[0]); join additional masters (masters[1:], role k3s_masters); retire verified replaced worker Nodes (workers, role k3s_node_retirement); join workers (workers, role k3s_workers); recover nodes drained by Terraform (localhost); bootstrap cluster (localhost, role bootstrap_cluster). Job handoff runs on a GitHub-hosted runner, decrypts the artifact and writes the organization secret KUBECONFIG_RAW for terraform and apps. Play 8 in order: CSI topology labels, a second CoreDNS replica, the Sealed Secrets key, TLS certificates restored from the NFS backup, the pinned helm-diff plugin, Argo CD from its Helm chart, and the root app cluster-bootstrap that points Argo CD at the apps repository.
svg.text: One deploy, from trigger to hand-off

g.text: the lock must still be ours
Wait for SSH availability on all nodes
Downloads and decrypts the artifact, checks that it is a kubeconfig,
then replaces the organization secret with gh secret set.
